meta.title: Moving the end of a draft RFQ-only round does not break the server
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The exact increase of the round end by 3600 seconds cannot be expressed because the available time tokens do not include {{roundEnd+3600}}; the operation uses its default increase instead.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an RFQ (pricing) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_…”.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
